request.system:
You read one Slack thread of a hardware engineering program.
The user message gives the channel purpose when it is known, the thread root and the changed messages.
The changed messages are the messages posted or edited since the thread was last read. This delta is the set of changed messages.
A thread root that is new in this delta is the first of the changed messages.
Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that the changed messages carry project information: a decision, a blocker, a risk, a schedule change, a spec change, a BOM change, an ask about the program, or an fyi that a program member needs to know.
Small talk, thanks and social messages are not project information.
Write the rationale first, then the probability.

messages.content:
Channel purpose: RFQs, POs, shipments, allocation and clear-to-build

Thread root:
new in this delta: it is the first changed message below
Changed messages, oldest first:
[ts 1791991800.010021] author U0SC01: Heads up: I placed PO-45002211 for 50x PN-31010 Rev B. Reposting the Monday PLM note here too: ECO-0142 moved PN-31010 from Rev B to Rev C.
[ts 1791991980.010022] author U0EE01: Yep, PN-31010 should now be Rev C after ECO-0142. Rev B on the harness PO is the mismatch.
[ts 1791992100.010023] author U0EM01: Thanks for catching it, <@U0SC01>. Can we pause release against PO-45002211 until the rev is corrected?
[ts 1791992280.010024] author U0SC01: I’ll contact the supplier and ask to update PO-45002211 from Rev B to Rev C. Not treating it as clear-to-build until they confirm.
[ts 1791992460.010025] author U0PM01: Please keep the qty at 50 when you revise it. I’ll note the risk on the build tracker.
